Hannah (PM): Quick post-launch triage thread. We need to carve the hotfix lane for next 48h. Items: 1) customer-reported embedding drift on long docs, 2) intermittent streaming clipping on iOS background, 3) admin console export failing for large orgs.
Luca: embedding drift looks like it started after the quantized variant push last night. Customer says search recall dropped for long paragraphs.
Priya: I can run an eval vs the customer's corpus this morning. If median cosine drops >0.12 we should roll back the quantized variant in the affected pools.
Marta (SRE): admin export failures are throwing 413s from the API gateway when the CSV is >120MB. I can enable a temporary ingress bypass for exports while we patch streaming chunking. Ops impact low but affects multiple accounts.
Kai (Design): iOS clipping: UX team repro'd 150100ms token loss when the app goes to background. We saw it spike on older devices. Short-term we can buffer last chunk and replay; longer-term we need to persist socket state.
Hannah (PM): proposed triage: must-fix = embeddings (customer SLA), urgent = iOS clipping (activation risk), backlog = admin export (workaround + patch next sprint). Agree?
Luca: agree. For embeddings I'll add a canary gate: pause quantized rollout on dedicated pools until regression tests pass.
Priya: ETA for eval suite run: 6 hours. If we hit regression threshold I'll open a rollback PR and schedule a canary rollback.
Marta (SRE): enabling ingress bypass for exports now on pool-2. Will monitor error rate. rollout-bot, can you note the change?
rollout-bot: ingress bypass toggle applied to pool-2 at 2026-03-23T08:45:00Z. Monitoring enabled for 48h.
Kai (Design): I'll ship an SDK patch that buffers the final 250ms chunk on iOS and retries once resume is detected. Canary to beta tonight.
Hannah (PM): acceptance criteria:
- Embeddings: customer corpus median similarity within 0.1 of baseline across 95% samples OR rollback applied. Validation window: 36h.
- iOS clipping: SDK patch deployed to beta + 48h telemetry showing 40% reduction in clip events on affected devices.
- Admin export: ingress bypass in place without new 413s for 24h; permanent fix scheduled next sprint.
Luca: owners: embeddings = Luca + Priya; iOS = Kai; export = Marta. I'll flag the model-variant in the rollout board as "paused".
Priya: posting preliminary eval results here when done. If we rollback, I'll include a small diff script and provable seed set.
Marta (SRE): will post logs from ingress and keep an eye on CPU/memory during bypass.
Hannah (PM): communicating to affected customers: offer temporary routing to hosted endpoints and an SLA credit if not resolved within 48h. I'll draft the note.
Luca: ok, pausing rollout and waiting on Priya. Thanks team.
Hannah (PM): follow-up sync tomorrow 09:30 PT or sooner if rollback triggered.
